notes.title: Version 1.02 Update:
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where skipping cutscenes (Fast-Forward) could prevent achievements from unlocking.

Prologue content optimizations:
(1) Adjusted the pacing of the plot for character introductions.
(2) Removed some of the backstory dialogue between Melinda and Salvio  to improve pacing.
(3) Simplified some dialogues for other characters.

Removed asterisks (*) from narrative descriptions for a cleaner visual presentation.

Addressed inappropriate exposure during the confrontation scene between Tiana and Ryann.

All walking animations have been remade using self-taught Spine techniques, resulting in smoother movement.

Rewrote the save system to fix corrupted save issues. This update aims to be the last time such issues occur.

The birthday song and festival broadcast can now be skipped.

The Steam Deck version update is postponed until Saturday.

notes.title: THE LAKE LADY is Now Live on the September 6!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Doctors,[/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone! The day is finally here—launch day! We are incredibly excited and can’t wait to share our story with all of you![/p][p align="start"]The game will be officially released at [b]11:00 AM on September 6[/b], with a base price of [b]¥32[/b]. During the first week, you can enjoy a [b]10% discount[/b]![/p][p align="start"]After extensive discussions and refinements, [i]THE LAKE LADY[/i] has undergone multiple rounds of content redesign. In the game, you will play as a surgeon searching for your missing daughter while uncovering secrets related to the Lake Lady and the hidden truths behind seemingly ordinary people.[/p][p align="start"]The game currently features multiple story branches (including the Normal Route, Power Route, Human Route, Spirit Route, etc.) and [b]10 different endings[/b]. The gameplay is not limited to visual novel-style text interactions—it also includes side-scrolling walking simulations, simple side-scrolling chase sequences, and QTE-based chase events tailored to the plot. Additionally, there are unique gameplay mechanics such as [b]surgery operations[/b] and [b]talisman combat[/b], allowing players to explore the truth in various ways.[/p][p align="start"]A [b]demo version[/b] remains available during the launch period! And today, coincidentally, is the Ghost Festival—what better time to dive into [i]THE LAKE LADY[/i] for a thrilling and immersive experience?[/p][p align="start"]Finally, we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all you Doctors for your continuous support. From the early stages when the game was still taking shape to now, your trust and encouragement have been indispensable. We hope you will continue to stand by us on this journey![/p][p align="start"]—From the Development Team of [i]THE LAKE LADY[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: 【THE LAKE LADY】DEMO NOW IS AVAILABLE ON STEAM
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
1. Resolution Adaptation Issue: Replaced direct prefab loading with UI prefab loading to match the canvas.
2. Long Initial Loading Time: Added a special effect tutorial to force right-click skipping of the loading screen.
3. Save File Issues: (1) Lost saves due to PC model compatibility; (2) Mini-games unable to save.
4. Invisible Bug: Set game state to idle during puzzles to ensure smooth interactions.
5. Mini-game Issue: Disabled skipping puzzles by scrolling down to prevent accidental skips, ensuring players engage with the game.

Detailed Modifications:
1. Adjusted some dialogues, added transitions, and detailed descriptions, tweaking lines that didn't fit character profiles.
2. Introduced new gameplay mechanics: long press to wait with screen vibration, implemented in item removal and hemostat interaction.
3. Added investigation points, designed multi-point investigations as optional, using mouse clicks for item retrieval and interactions to enhance smoothness.
4. Removed outer glow guidance for all clickable points except for special cases, now showing edge glow on mouse hover to reduce guidance and increase immersion.
5. Added background music and ambient sounds.
6. New interface sound effects, like clicking anywhere on the screen during dialogues to continue the conversation.
7. Enhanced and adjusted some music and sound effects: (1) Added spatial reverb to children's singing; (2) Added voice interference to news broadcasts, set to auto-play.
8. Added and adjusted some item UIs.
9. Modified the chase scene with the window and ghost into three sets, adding chanting sound effects.
10. Optimized all transition times.
11. Replaced the entire scene in the ward.
12. Improved the map travel representation from the office to the ward.
13. Corrected some Chinese and English typos.
14. Changed the game's main interface to a red blood mist and flowing hair effect as the background, making buttons simple and easy to identify.
15. Reconstructed some dream sequences, removing all AI assets.
